Does not upload, prepare, send, sign, or continuously poll. Returns {statuses: [...]} containing only distinct observed values: preparation_succes

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "send_prepared_signature_document" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_free_signature_document, send_prepared_signature_document, prepare_and_send_free_signature_document, get_signature_document_status · Private data: prepare_free_signature_document, send_prepared_signature_document, prepare_and_send_free_signature_document, get_signature_document_status · Public sink: prepare_free_signature_document, send_prepared_signature_document, prepare_and_send_free_signature_document, get_signature_document_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_free_signature_document, send_prepared_signature_document, prepare_and_send_free_signature_document, get_signature_document_status · Private data: prepare_free_signature_document, send_prepared_signature_document, prepare_and_send_free_signature_document, get_signature_document_status · Public sink: prepare_free_signature_document, send_prepared_signature_document, prepare_and_send_free_signature_document, get_signature_document_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
